description: This map illustrates different types of agricultural land cover and infrastructure within a generic agricultural area. The legend defines four categories: "Irrigated arable land" is depicted in bright green. "Non-irrigated arable land" forms the background in light yellow/beige. "Roads" are shown as thin grey lines delineating rectangular parcels and some curvilinear paths. One specific feature, "Center-pivot irrigation", is represented by a pie chart symbol, which shows segments of dark green, light green, and beige, indicating a mixed land use or irrigation pattern within that specific circular area. The map displays a grid-like arrangement of parcels, some of which are irrigated.
